name: WibbleWobbleVR
summary: A SteamVR driver that converts VR game output to frame sequential format, enabling play on OLED displays using 120Hz page-flipped stereo (Sequential-View output). Targeted at high-refresh OLED panels and active-shutter display setups without a physical VR headset.
compatibility_notes: Requires SteamVR and a 120Hz+ display. OLED panels are preferred for their near-zero response time between left/right frames. Introduces crosstalk on slow-response LCD panels.
